profile.headline: Data Scientist | Data Engineer | Software Developer | Machine Learning | AI
profile.summary:
I am a data scientist and data engineer, with fullstack software engineering experience.. I recently graduated with a Master of Science in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence from Georgia Institute of Technology.


I have deep and broad experience in transforming information, often stored in cumbersome legacy systems, into efficient, modern databases, the analytics from which support executive strategy. With these reports and analyses, we can fully support a common understanding of the facts, backed by hard information, and based on tests of multiple scenarios and hypotheses.

The most important work I have done has provided predictive analytics for management, so they can easily and confidently determine corporate strategy. While working with my non-technical colleagues, I help them understand the broad potential of these technologies, and they give me powerful insight into the business. This collaboration is unparalleled, and our collective intelligence supports our organizational goals.

My current interests include architecting and delivering AI and machine learning tools that take these analytics and reporting to the next level. My coursework in machine learning and artificial intelligence, matched with my proven experience as a fullstack engineer and database expert, has prepared me for these software development and strategic roles.

To learn more about my background, please connect with me on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Data Engineer / Analyst
positions.description:
I was brought into Action Target to expand its data warehouse and data analysis capabilities, as I was completing a Master of Science in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence through Georgia Institute of Technology (2018). 

At the time I began this role, the company did not have an organized data solution. Most of my work thus involved creating and delivering a comprehensive data warehousing and reporting strategy:

> Reducing IT time consumption and enabling end users to self-generate reports in Tableau and other systems. I used a combination of Postgres and MongoDB for the data storage, C# web API via ODATA for the pipeline, and reporting via Tableau, Excel, Power BI, or other applications.

> Building a front-end web interface for self-service reporting with a C# web API and Node.js, capitalizing on my prior frontend/fullstack expertise.

> Developing analytics reporting on shop floor data using Python and C# to extract Excel data and migrate it to Postgres database, which users could query and analyze via my SQL scripts. These nearly real-time analyses helped management make better decisions about shop floor processes and strategies.

> Similarly, setting up a system that reduced report generation from multiple hours per week to about 15 minutes. These financial reports were cumbersome, inefficient, and slow. I replaced that legacy system with one that allowed users to generate the analytics and reports they needed quickly. Technologies I used included SQL, Python, C#, VBA, Excel, and Tableau.

> Migrating Sharepoint data into a Data Warehouse.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Database Admin
positions.description:
I was initially recruited as a database engineer through a co-op program; within 2 years, I earned a full-time role with much broader oversight as a fullstack developer with database administration components. 

Over time, I was awarded multiple gold, silver, and bronze achievement awards for outstanding performance as a software engineer.

Technologies and Software Development Languages:

VBA, Python, Perl, and Windows Batch Scripts, Excel Reporting, Custom Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) Interfaces
C#, SQL, MySQL, SAP, Oracle

My major accomplishments involved automating manual, error-prone, and resource-intensive processes. Examples of my successes include:

> Designing a one-touch testing and test results recording system in C# and MySQL, which informed our leadership team on our processes and enabled them to make better strategic decisions based on nearly real-time data.

> Cleaning data housed in legacy systems and migrating the information quickly via a high-quality process, enabling the company to implement SAP and Oracle across the businesses. For this complex process, I wrote custom SQL, VBA, Python, and C# scripts to analyze and transform the data. I thus saved the company thousands of hours by developing a system that completed the migration in a few days.

> Developing custom and on-demand reporting in Excel and Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) interfaces. Reporting time was lagging behind management’s need to make strategic decisions, as reporting was a complicated process that only the IT team could do. With a self-serve model that engaged custom data pipelines and merged a variety of resources, I cut reporting time down significantly.
